About Humanity First Lawn Care

Amazing Lawns. Amazing People. Amazing Communities.

Humanity First Lawn Care was built on a simple belief: business can be a force for good.

We believe a great community starts with people who care about one another, and that when people are given opportunity, responsibility, and someone willing to believe in them, amazing things can happen.

Humanity First Lawn Care is a locally focused lawn care company with a mission that goes beyond creating beautiful outdoor spaces. We're here to provide professional lawn care while creating meaningful employment opportunities for people who are rebuilding their lives and working toward a better future.

Meet Our Founder

Humanity First Lawn Care was founded by Greg Beehler, an entrepreneur, real estate investor, and community-minded business owner who believes that success means more when it can be used to help others succeed.

Greg's journey in business has shaped the way he looks at opportunity. Through his work in real estate, he has seen firsthand that buildings are more than bricks and mortar — they are places where people live, work, struggle, grow, and build their lives.

That perspective led to a bigger question: what if business could create opportunities for people who simply need someone to give them a chance?

Humanity First Lawn Care is part of Greg's answer. The vision is to build a company where people can come to work, learn valuable skills, develop confidence, take pride in what they accomplish, and begin rebuilding their lives through meaningful employment.

Greg believes that people shouldn't be defined by the hardest chapter of their lives. They should be given the opportunity to write the next one. That philosophy is at the heart of Humanity First.

More Than Lawn Care

We take our responsibility to our customers seriously. When you hire Humanity First Lawn Care, you should expect professional service, attention to detail, reliability, and a lawn you can be proud of.

But we also want your decision to support something bigger. Every customer who chooses Humanity First helps us create more opportunities to employ people, develop skills, build confidence, and strengthen our community.

Our goal isn't simply to build a successful lawn care company. It's to build a company that creates success for other people, too. As we grow, we want to expand the opportunities we can provide — from entry-level employment and practical skills to leadership, responsibility, and eventually the ability for people to build careers of their own.

We believe work can be transformational. It can provide income, but it can also provide structure, purpose, confidence, relationships, and a sense of belonging. And sometimes, that first opportunity can be the beginning of an entirely different future.

Our Vision

We want Humanity First Lawn Care to become more than a company that maintains properties. We want to become a company that helps people move forward — a company that customers are proud to support, that employees are proud to work for, and that communities are better because of.

We believe that when we put humanity first, everything else has a better chance to follow: better businesses, better opportunities, better neighbourhoods, better communities.

A better lawn. A stronger community. A little more humanity in everything we do.

Our Quality Commitment

At Humanity First Lawncare, our name is our standard. We put people first, which means the families whose yards we care for, the neighbors who share the space around them, and the team members who do the work. Every lawn we touch is a reflection of that promise.

Our Promise to You

We treat your property like our own. We show up prepared, work carefully around your gardens, walkways, and belongings, and leave your property cleaner than we found it. Clippings are cleared from driveways, sidewalks, and patios before we go.

We do the job right the first time. Our crews are trained in proper mowing heights, clean edging, precise trimming, and thorough cleanup. We sharpen our blades regularly, because dull blades tear grass and invite disease. Cutting cleanly keeps your lawn healthier and better looking.

We show up when we say we will. Your time matters. We keep consistent schedules, communicate promptly if weather or circumstances cause a delay, and never leave you wondering when to expect us.

We communicate openly and honestly. If we notice a problem, such as pests, disease, drainage trouble, or bare patches, we tell you plainly and explain your options. We recommend only the services your lawn actually needs, never extras to pad an invoice.

Our Standards of Care

Healthy lawns, not just tidy ones. We follow practices that support long-term turf health: mowing at the right height for the season, alternating patterns to prevent wear, and adjusting our approach to the weather and the condition of your grass.

Responsible use of products and resources. Where fertilizers, weed control, or other treatments are part of your service, we apply them carefully, follow label directions, and take extra care around children, pets, waterways, and pollinators. We would rather make a thoughtful choice than a quick one.

Safety on every job. Our team is trained to use equipment safely, keep debris from reaching people and vehicles, and respect your neighbors' space. Protecting people always comes before finishing quickly.

Respect for the people on our crews. Quality starts with good people who feel valued. We invest in training, fair treatment, and proper equipment, because a supported team takes pride in its work.

If We Miss the Mark

We hold ourselves accountable. If something isn't right, tell us within a reasonable time after your service and we will return to make it right at no charge. You will always reach a real person who listens, takes responsibility, and follows through. We would rather hear about a concern and fix it than lose your trust quietly.

Our Measure of Success

We don't judge our work only by how a lawn looks the day we leave. We measure it by whether you're glad you hired us, whether your lawn is healthier season after season, and whether you would comfortably recommend us to a neighbor.

Humanity First Lawncare: Caring for your lawn, and the people who live on it.

Learn: lawn care tips

Mow high. Keep grass about 3 inches tall to shade out weeds and hold moisture.

Water deeply. One long soak a week beats a little every day.

Keep blades sharp. Clean cuts heal faster and keep grass healthy.

Cleanup twice a year. Spring and fall clearing prevents matting and disease.

Water in the morning. Early watering lets grass dry out during the day, which helps prevent the fungus and disease that thrive in damp, cool conditions overnight.

Overseed thin spots in fall. Cooler temperatures and steady moisture give new grass seed the best chance to establish before winter.

Leave the clippings sometimes. Short clippings left on the lawn break down quickly and return nitrogen to the soil — just bag them after a heavier cut.

Aerate compacted soil. Heavy foot traffic and clay soil compact over time; aeration opens up the ground so water, air and nutrients can reach the roots.

Feed on a schedule, not a whim. A light spring feeding and a fall feeding do more for lawn health than one heavy application mid-summer.
